scope: All 23 saved native GigaTIME channels for all eight automatic nuclear-QC passes among the first 79 completed expansion fields; scanner RGB and DAPI/StarDist shown beside each channel.
common_findings: No obvious sharp rectangular tiling shadow was visible at contact-sheet scale. Several markers have broadly similar displayed morphology, but each preview was independently contrast-stretched; native-channel rank analysis does not support describing all channels as duplicates. Contact sheets alone cannot verify protein identity, cellular specificity, or full-resolution shadow absence.

records.technical_visual_finding: DAPI peaks mostly track sparse visible nuclei, with broad halos; no apparent rectangular seam. CD20 dynamic range is flagged near-flat by native marker QC.
DAPI broadly follows the mixed-cell nuclei, although peaks are larger than several StarDist outlines. No apparent rectangular seam.
Sparse kidney-cell nuclei have corresponding DAPI peaks, with some diffuse background and no apparent rectangular seam.
DAPI mostly corresponds to independent outlines in the breast field; multiple virtual proteins show bright shared cell morphology. No apparent rectangular seam.

Narrow erythrocyte-rich strip with few detected nuclei. Nineteen of 23 channels have near-flat native dynamic range and the median pairwise nuclear-pixel channel rho is 0.732; independent marker information is inadequately supported.

Dense lymphoid region has confluent bright virtual DAPI and several broadly bright protein maps. Numeric DAPI QC passes, but individual-cell separation in the virtual signal is difficult to verify at contact-sheet scale.
Sparse blood-rich prostate field; DAPI peaks often correspond to visible nuclei. CD138, CD20, Actin-D and Transgelin are flagged near-flat by native marker QC.
DAPI peaks partly agree with independent outlines but are broader than many nuclei. No apparent rectangular seam.

classifier_rule: Do not silently treat automatic DAPI QC pass as whole-panel acceptance. Preserve review/exclusion flags and keep measured-marker and test-cell validity separate from technical image QC.
publication_limit: No image is yet certified protein-specific or shadow-free at full resolution. Do not update the public classifier score from this partial cohort.
